hypothesis: The C-only create_subroom:rnd edge might omit or change random size/position draws and edge adjustments in nested room APIs.
supportedSetup: Production startup and public floor initialization. Parent des.region has explicit dimensions, arrival_room true and lit 0. Inside its contents, des.room requests a vault child with chance 0, filled 0, lit 0 and explicit or paired random coordinates/dimensions. Parent bounds independently asserted. Capture child callback before finalization.
expectedC: create_subroom rejects parent dimensions below four without drawing. Valid cases draw width/height before x/y, normalize x/y=1 to zero and shift far-edge abutments by one before handing bounds to add_subroom.
observedJS: All ten acceptance/bounds/RNG-consumption cases match executed C under checked shared draw tapes.
control: Two explicit edge-adjustment controls, two seeds for random-position/random-size/minimum-parent cases, and narrow/short parent rejection controls with zero draws and no child callback.
scope: Ten create_subroom parameter/acceptance cases only. Does not prove add_subroom allocation, room topology, collisions between siblings, full metadata, independent ISAAC parity, filling, finalization or orig_rtype.
oracleProvenance: Unchanged C create_subroom body. Fixed parent bounds match independently asserted public parent postconditions. rnd replays the valid JS tape with bound/value/exhaustion checks; litstate_rnd accepts only fixed 0. add_subroom captures its bounds/type/lit/special parameters rather than allocating C room state.
